name: cx-goal-many-rules
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards. Then open the door with the key and pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clauses capture the task. Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) records the stated order; the hard Existence(door_open) with Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) forces the key to be taken, which with the first Precedence forces the ball moved; Existence(target_picked_up) is the goal. The soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' (key_lost's definition already encodes 'before the door was opened', so plain Absence is right), and the soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) matches the preference-scoped 'whenever holding the key, have the door open or open it afterwards'. No redundant or added clauses.
